# zerops_service_env_vars (Data Source)

All generated and user environment variables returned by the service API. Values are stored in state. Without sudo, masks are retained and this is not a plaintext credential source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zerops_service_env_vars" "app" {
  service_id = zerops_service.app.id
}

# The entire vars map is sensitive and is stored in Terraform state.
# Non-sudo credentials may return masks rather than usable credentials.
output "service_environment" {
  value     = data.zerops_service_env_vars.app.vars
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) Service to read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service ID.
- `vars` (Map of String, Sensitive) Complete environment keyed by exact variable name, including generated connection strings. Server masks remain masks when plaintext is unavailable.
